You are matching code-review findings against a known bug. Reply with ONLY a JSON object. KNOWN BUG: The dialog's focus trap counts hidden or tabIndex=-1 elements as tabbable (for example the library's own hidden TabPanels inside a Dialog), so Tab moves focus somewhere invisible. Rules: - Answer "yes" only if the text describes THIS specific bug: the same faulty behaviour in the same situation. A finding about a nearby but different behaviour (another header, another edge case, a different race) is "no". - A finding that says the behaviour was checked and PASSED, or that the code handles it correctly, is "no". - Wording does not matter; the behaviour does. === REVIEW FINDINGS === - [blocking] Dialog trap leaks after a backdrop click. With the parent keeping `open` true, `await u.click(backdrop); await u.tab();` moves focus to a button outside the dialog (`active= outside BUTTON`; the probe asserting focus stays inside failed with "expected false to be true"). Cause: the backdrop is not focusable, so focus drops to `body`, and the Tab keydown handler never fires because it is bound on the dialog. README's "Tab and Shift+Tab stay inside the dialog" is therefore false in this state. - [blocking] Combobox Enter with no active option inside a `
` submits the form (`submit calls = 1`). README says Enter "Does nothing when no option is active", and the criterion says "does nothing harmful". The handler never calls preventDefault on that path. Decide whether to suppress implicit submission or reword the README. - [minor] Clicking the Combobox input does not open the listbox (`aria-expanded` stayed `false`). The README is silent, but it is a usability gap. - [minor] `description=""` renders an empty `

` and sets `aria-describedby` to it. Reproduced. The criterion says "only when a description is given", so this is an edge-case question. - [minor] Dialog nested inside an open Combobox: the first Escape closes only the listbox and the dialog stays open (reproduced). This matches the README but is arguably at odds with "Escape pressed in a nested input still closes". See OPEN QUESTIONS. - [minor, not reproduced] Tabs `enabled` order is refreshed only when Tabs or a Tab re-renders. A wrapper that reorders children without re-rendering Tabs could leave the fallback tab stop stale. I did not build this case. Reply exactly: {"found": "yes"|"no", "finding_quote": "", "blocking": "yes"|"no"} "blocking" is "yes" only if the matching finding is tagged [blocking].
